functional_profile.parent_approval: Explicit reachable second-order functional profile only; SOC-16 full completion and exact S3 waveform gates remain open
functional_profile.quantizer: q(v)=+128 when v>=0, else -128; physical bit=(q+128)/256

bounded_state.oracle: Independent double-cumulative output-minus-input discrepancy, not production tick-copy
bounded_state.invariant: Every density-changing path restarts zero errors. Divider/source/gate changes do not change density or errors. Arbitrary nonzero-error seeds are NOT generally stable.
bounded_state.transfer_identity: Checked every independent reference pulse; each certified orbit has exact documented mean
bounded_state.qualification_boundary: Exercised mathematical profile reference only, not native pulses/RC/ADC or silicon bitstream

functional_profile.reset: error1=error2=0; density=0; divider=256; pulse phase=0; physical output-low; function clock disabled
functional_profile.density_change: Seeds delayed input from new density and restarts zero-error trajectory; explicit functional assumption, NOT claimed silicon behavior
functional_profile.divider_change: Retains relative progress through divided pulse cycle and both error states
functional_profile.clock_source_change_and_stop: Source-phase progress and both error states retained; output holds actual last value, not high-Z or fictitious unpowered
functional_profile.timing: Integer-nanosecond deadline ceil with retained source-cycle phase in billionths; one persistent timer, at most eight pulse evolutions per dispatch; overdue phase retained with positive-time rescheduling
functional_profile.analog_boundary: Only raw physical PDM edges enter ONE matrix-source authority. External finite rails/drivers/passive RC solver produces measured mean and ripple; connected ADC samples solver voltage, never a fixed mean/code.

cg.meaning: configuration-register clock enable, not function-clock enable

documented_hardware.pulse_cycle: One divided clock cycle per PDM pulse output cycle
documented_hardware.output_enable: All eight peripheral outputs enabled by default; GPIO matrix/pad enable determines external drive

idf_driver_semantics.allocation: One shared group, eight independent software-owned channels; ninth allocation ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND; deletion releases channel/pad
idf_driver_semantics.invert_out: GPIO matrix inversion, not an invented SDM register
idf_driver_semantics.enable_disable: IDF6.1 channel_enable/disable change software FSM and PM lock only; no per-channel hardware enable register
